name: Alternaria_Leaf_Spot
symptoms: Small brown to black spots on leaves Spots often have concentric rings forming a 'target-like' pattern Yellow halo around lesions Lesions enlarge and may merge together Leaf yellowing and premature leaf drop Severe infections can reduce plant growth and yield
management: cultural: Use certified disease-free seeds and planting materials Practice crop rotation with non-host crops Remove and destroy infected plant debris after harvest Improve air circulation by proper plant spacing and pruning Avoid overhead irrigation when possible chemical: Apply protective fungicides such as Mancozeb Use Chlorothalonil-based fungicides Copper-based fungicides can help reduce disease spread Rotate fungicides with different FRAC groups to avoid resistance biological: Use biological control agents such as Bacillus subtilis formulations Encourage beneficial microorganisms that suppress fungal pathogens
